To convert 72 degrees Fahrenheit to Celsius, you can use the formula:

$$\text{Celsius} = (\text{Fahrenheit} - 32) \times \frac{5}{9}$$

1. Subtract 32 from 72: 
   $72 - 32 = 40$
2. Multiply by 5: 
   $40 \times 5 = 200$
3. Divide by 9: 
   $200 \div 9 \approx 22.22$

72 degrees Fahrenheit is approximately **22.2°C**.
